description: Run one WP-CLI command on the site, without the leading "wp", e.g. "post create --post_type=page --post_title=About --post_status=publish --porcelain". Put long content in stdin and use "-" as the file argument. eval, shell and db import/export are not available.

site.description: the site name, from create_site or list_sites

token.description: the token create_site returned (oxa_...); leave out when Oxyforge is connected with an account agent key

name: run_wp_cli
title: Run a WP-CLI command
